title: Edge traffic
description: Every request through the Traefik edge: rate, errors and duration per service, then who sent them, from where, and which requests failed or ran slow.

links.title: Fleet overview
links.tooltip: Start page: every host, service and signal at a glance

list.name: node
list.label: Edge
list.description: Edge proxy, one per cluster node.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Requests per second for the selection.

panels.title: 5xx share
panels.description: Share of requests answered 5xx. These are failures of a backend or the edge.

panels.title: 4xx share
panels.description: Share of requests answered 4xx: unknown paths, missing auth, refused methods.

panels.title: Latency p50
panels.description: Median request duration.

panels.title: Latency p95
panels.description: 95th percentile request duration. Traefik buckets end at 0.1, 0.3, 1.2 and 5 s.

panels.title: Sent
panels.description: Response bytes per second for the selection.

panels.title: Services
panels.description: Each service over the selected range. Select a service to narrow the whole dashboard to it.

panels.title: Requests by service
panels.description: Requests per second per service.

panels.title: Server errors by service
panels.description: 5xx responses per second per service.

panels.title: Latency p95 by service
panels.description: 95th percentile duration per service.

panels.title: Traffic by service
panels.description: Bytes per second sent to clients, received from clients below zero.

panels.title: Requests by edge
panels.description: Requests per second per edge proxy and entry point. websecure carries HTTPS, web only redirects.

panels.title: Open connections by edge
panels.description: Connections held open per edge proxy and protocol.

panels.title: Top clients
panels.description: Client addresses by request count. Network marks internet, LAN or tailnet sources. Select an address to see everything it reached across the fleet.

targets.expr: log.type:=access edge.service:in($svc) k8s.node.name:in($node) | stats by (ClientHost, client.network, geo.country_name, geo.city_name) count() requests, count() if (DownstreamStatus:>=400) errors, sum(DownstreamContentSize) bytes, count_uniq(RequestHost) hosts | sort by (requests desc) | limit 100

panels.title: Where requests come from
panels.description: Client locations by request count. Private and tailnet clients have no location.

targets.expr: log.type:=access edge.service:in($svc) k8s.node.name:in($node) geo.location.lat:* | stats by (geo.location.lat, geo.location.lon, geo.city_name, geo.country_name) count() requests

panels.title: Requests by client network
panels.description: Requests per interval from internet, LAN and tailnet clients.

targets.expr: log.type:=access edge.service:in($svc) k8s.node.name:in($node) | stats by (client.network) count() requests

panels.title: Requests by country
panels.description: Request count per client country over the selected range.

targets.expr: log.type:=access edge.service:in($svc) k8s.node.name:in($node) | stats by (geo.country_name) count() requests | sort by (requests desc) | limit 15

panels.title: Top hostnames and paths
panels.description: Requested hostname and path by count, with the slowest median.

targets.expr: log.type:=access edge.service:in($svc) k8s.node.name:in($node) | stats by (RequestHost, RequestPath) count() requests, quantile(0.5, duration_ms) p50_ms, count() if (DownstreamStatus:>=400) errors | sort by (requests desc) | limit 50

panels.title: User agents
panels.description: Client software by request count. Bots and scanners show up here first.

targets.expr: log.type:=access edge.service:in($svc) k8s.node.name:in($node) | stats by (request_User-Agent) count() requests, count_uniq(ClientHost) clients | sort by (requests desc) | limit 30

panels.title: Status codes by service
panels.description: Response code counts per service over the selected range.

targets.expr: log.type:=access edge.service:in($svc) k8s.node.name:in($node) | stats by (edge.service, DownstreamStatus) count() requests | sort by (requests desc) | limit 50

panels.title: Failed requests
panels.description: Requests answered 5xx, newest first. Each line: client, method, host and path, status, duration.

panels.title: Slow requests
panels.description: Requests that took longer than one second, newest first.

panels.title: Certificates
panels.description: Every cert-manager certificate with its expiry and readiness. Renewal starts 30 days before expiry.
